subject: *: support indexlookup pushdown for next-gen (#64665)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent for executor/store behavior. Changes are confined to unistore mock coprocessor handling: propagate `KeyspaceId` from `coprocessor.Request.Context` into execution context and, in nextgen builds, prefix table row keys via `tikv.NewCodecV2(...).EncodeKey` before region lookup/range construction for IndexLookUp pushdown. Executor changes are test-only (remove nextgen skips). No Blocker/High correctness/semantics/consistency issues found; later history shows subsequent feature follow-ups but nothing indicating a necessary fix for these specific changes.
